research_sources: Kurzgesagt production breakdowns (Epic Mountain original scores)

non_negotiable_rules.voice_is_king: Everything mixed relative to voice, never the other way around
non_negotiable_rules.sfx_density_long_form: 1-2 SFX per minute for documentary, 2-4 for educational, 4-6 for finance/business
non_negotiable_rules.whoosh_timing: Start 2-4 frames BEFORE the cut, not on it. Peak and tail hits the edit point.
non_negotiable_rules.impact_timing: Land EXACTLY on the visual moment. Frame-accurate. Even 2 frames late feels loose.
non_negotiable_rules.riser_timing: Start 1-3 seconds before reveal. End riser on cut, follow with impact hit.
non_negotiable_rules.music_under_speech: Music at -24dB to -30dB below voice. Felt, not heard.
non_negotiable_rules.phone_speaker_test: If any SFX makes you think 'that's a sound effect', it's too loud or poorly timed
non_negotiable_rules.strategic_silence: 3-5 second windows where editing slows, music drops, ambient takes over. For a high to feel high, you need a low.
non_negotiable_rules.consistent_branding: Use same whoosh style, same impact type across all videos on a channel
non_negotiable_rules.max_sfx_per_window: 4 SFX per 5-minute window before diminishing returns

dialogue_voiceover.notes: Normalize first; this is the anchor

impact_hit.notes: Can be louder for emphatic moments

background_music_no_speech.notes: Can rise during B-roll and transitions

ui_micro_sounds.notes: Subtle clicks and pops on text

ducking.notes: Music rises back during pauses creating dynamic breathing mix

documentary_long_form.notes: Most restrained. Atmosphere does the work.

shorts.notes: Maximum density. Zero silence tolerance in first 3 seconds.

shorts_specific.opening_sfx: Start with punchy SFX synced to first word. Eliminate silent intro.

cinematic-documentary.philosophy: SFX are minimal and atmospheric. Music does the heavy lifting. Restraint maintains immersion.
cinematic-documentary.key_principle: Never adopt a dark and scary voice. Build tension through pacing and restraint.

true_crime.notes: Remove music completely for shocking reveals

history.notes: Match era. Hammer strikes for medieval, tractor engines for industrial.

food_travel.notes: Camera shutters on dish reveals. Bell dings on tips.

nature_space.notes: Layer field recordings over melodic base for thick sonic environment.

whoosh.variations: Maintain multiple whoosh variations. Never use same sound every 10 seconds.

impact_hit.timing: Land EXACTLY on visual moment. Frame-accurate.
impact_hit.notes: Use for statistics appearing, key claims, hard cuts.

riser.timing: Start 1-3 seconds before reveal. End on cut.
riser.follow_with: Impact hit immediately after riser ends

silence.emotional_peak: Remove all music for voiceover delivery

minimal.description: Clean, text-driven, kinetic typography. Vox/TED-Ed style.
minimal.philosophy: Text IS the visual. Sound supports text animation.

motion-graphics.description: Animated, data-driven, icon-based. Kurzgesagt/Infographics Show style.
motion-graphics.philosophy: SFX add depth without being consciously noticed. Subliminal immersion.

common_mistakes.sfx_too_loud: Viewer flinches then exits. Test on phone speaker.
common_mistakes.inconsistent_volume: Forces constant volume adjustment. Normalize to -14 LUFS.
common_mistakes.generic_stock_sfx: Feels cheap and recycled. Customize, layer, pitch-shift.
common_mistakes.timing_misalignment: Brain detects AV misalignment. Frame-accurate placement.
common_mistakes.no_ambient_room_tone: Audio cuts feel jarring. Always have ambient bed.
common_mistakes.no_audio_transitions: Hard cuts create audible clicks. Short fades 2-5 frames.
common_mistakes.testing_only_headphones: Mix sounds great on headphones, terrible on phone. Test on phone speaker.
common_mistakes.same_whoosh_every_time: Creates pattern habituation. Maintain multiple variations.

actually_used_by_creators.notes: Search for specific sounds, not concepts.

testing_protocol.phone_speaker_test: Export and play on phone speaker at medium volume. If any SFX makes you think 'that's a sound effect', it's too loud.
testing_protocol.golden_rule: This is how 80%+ of people actually watch.
